item.title: Nov 12, 2026: Stablecoin supply shrinks $14.2 billion in 30 days, Tron and Tether form new crime task force, KPMG signs off on Tether Gold audit
item.description:
Stablecoin supply has fallen by 14.2 billion dollars in 30 days, the largest decline since June 2022, according to Glassnode. Tron and Tether have formed a new crime task force with Chainalysis, and Tether says KPMG gave a clean audit opinion to the issuer of its gold token. Elsewhere, Nomura is reported to be weighing a sale of Laser Digital, and MSCI will drop Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes.

  • Tron and Tether form the Digital Crime Task Force with Chainalysis (The Block, Cointelegraph)
  • Tether says KPMG issued an unqualified audit opinion for the issuer of its gold token XAUT (Tether)
  • Securitize and Ethena switch on a liquidity facility of up to $100 million for BlackRock BUIDL (The Block)
  • Gemini sells its UK and European operations to stablecoin payments firm KAST for under $10 million, CoinDesk reports (CoinDesk, Blockhead)
  • Thailand SEC publishes draft rules capping stablecoin deposits and withdrawals at 5 million baht a day (Cointelegraph)
  • SoFiUSD goes live on Polygon (The Block)
  • BitGo adds USDC minting and redemption for institutional clients (The Block)
  • UK digital bank Griffin raises $20 million to expand stablecoin reserve services and cross-border payments (Cointelegraph, CoinDesk)
  • FIFA prediction market partner Predictstreet removes USD1 references and lists USDC, Bloomberg reports (Crypto Times)
  • DCS DeCard extends stablecoin-linked card issuing with Visa to more than 70 markets (Crypto Times)
  • Nomura weighs sale of crypto subsidiary Laser Digital, Bloomberg reports (CoinPost, Cointelegraph, NADA NEWS)
  • Ceres agrees a capital and business alliance with SBI Holdings (CoinPost, NADA NEWS)
  • Minna Bank and Backpack Japan sign a basic agreement on yen transfers and tokenized deposits (CoinPost, NADA NEWS, Atarashii Keizai)
  • Toppan and BitGo test three-party key management for digital assets, targeting a 2028 service (Atarashii Keizai, NADA NEWS)
  • SEC files a brief backing the CFTC in the lawsuit over single-stock perpetual futures (The Block, CoinPost, Atarashii Keizai)
  • South Korea to let exchanges suspend deposits and withdrawals on suspected hacks (Cointelegraph, CoinPost, Crypto Times)
  • Russian central bank says domestic exchanges can start crypto trading from November 22 (CoinPost, Atarashii Keizai)
  • London Stock Exchange eases listing rules for professional-only crypto ETNs, CoinDesk reports (bitbank)
  • MSCI to remove Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes after the November 30 close (The Block, CoinDesk, NADA NEWS)
  • Bitcoin falls as much as 3.5% after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; spot ETF outflows reach $1.44 billion over five sessions (Cointelegraph, Cointelegraph, CoinDesk)
  • DTCC plans to bring its tokenization service to Solana in the second half of 2027 (The Block)
  • BNY picks Figment to support staking on its custody platform (The Block)
  • Ethlabs proposes moving Ethereum post-quantum work up to 2027 and withdraws its faster-slot proposal (The Block, Cointelegraph, CoinDesk)
  • Pyth Network adds real-time stock and ETF data from five NYSE Group exchanges (The Block)
  • Polymarket lays off staff and ends contractor agreements, Bloomberg reports (CoinPost, CoinDesk)
  • Zcash holders to vote November 16 to 30 on removing 50,000 ZEC from the grants treasury (CoinDesk, bitbank)
  • Sygnum launches an ETH-denominated fund targeting 8% to 10% a year (The Block, NADA NEWS)
  • Israel Discount Bank to offer bitcoin and ether trading in its app from November 26 (Crypto Times, bitbank)
  • Sui wallet Suiet to shut down (Cointelegraph)
  • Chainstack says an AI-driven breach exposed customer names, emails and password hashes (The Block)
  • Indian exchange Unocoin keeps logins disabled for a fourth day after unauthorized server access (Crypto Times)
  • Ethereum client Lighthouse releases urgent security update v8.3.3 (bitbank)

item.title: Nov 11, 2026: Banks commit $270 million to joint stablecoin issuer, Japanese bank API halt pauses JPYC issuance, USDT supply shrinks $6.6 billion
item.description:
Goldman Sachs, Citi and other members of a 21-institution consortium are reported to be committing about 270 million dollars to a joint stablecoin issuer. GMO Aozora Net Bank halted its banking API twice, pausing issuance and redemption of the yen stablecoin JPYC, and CryptoQuant said USDT supply has shrunk by 6.6 billion dollars in 60 days. Elsewhere, bitcoin fell to its lowest since August 20 and the CFTC reportedly warned Kalshi of possible legal action.

  • Tom Emmer elected House Republican whip (Cointelegraph, bitbank)
  • Miami-Dade County accepts bitcoin for property taxes (CoinPost)
  • Bitcoin falls to about $72,700, its lowest since August 20, after hot U.S. CPI (Cointelegraph, NADA NEWS, CoinDesk)
  • Bitmine reports a $6.3 billion net loss for fiscal 2026 (The Block, CoinPost, NADA NEWS)
  • Zcash falls below $1,000 a day after Grayscale pledges $1 million to its ecosystem (Cointelegraph, The Block, NADA NEWS)
  • Barclays raises its IBIT stake 48%; Citi discloses a new $119 million FBTC position (Cointelegraph, bitbank)

  • OKXICE to start tokenized securities trading on November 23 with more than 70 assets (The Block, CoinDesk)
  • Kraken parent Payward adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks (The Block, Cointelegraph, CoinDesk)
  • Deutsche Bank goes live with crypto custody and signs a tokenization MoU with Deutsche Asset Management (The Block, CoinPost, Cointelegraph)
  • Plume affiliate Kimber Digital Securities registers as a U.S. broker-dealer and joins FINRA (Cointelegraph, Atarashii Keizai, CoinDesk)
  • Moody's and Chainlink complete a cross-chain credit ratings pilot (The Block, Atarashii Keizai, CoinPost)
  • Polymarket's U.S. exchange volume rises 266% from June to October (Cointelegraph, Crypto Times)
  • Bullish names former NYSE president Stacey Cunningham as president (bitbank, CoinDesk)
  • Ripple Prime head Marc Asch to step down at year-end (bitbank)
  • Alta raises a $47.5 million Series A for a blockchain for financial institutions (The Block)
  • MegaETH Foundation rebrands as MEGA and commits $30 million to new products (The Block, bitbank)
  • Partner of Nomura's Laser Digital launches a Saudi SME credit vault on BNB Chain (The Block)
  • Helius releases Solana Privacy Rings on mainnet (Atarashii Keizai, bitbank)
  • Jupiter announces four new products (Atarashii Keizai, Crypto Times)
  • Across bridge domain hijacked; affected users to be made whole (The Block, Cointelegraph, Crypto Times)
  • Initia loses about $3.27 million in its second attack in three weeks (Cointelegraph, bitbank)
  • Bitcoin Core discloses three previously patched vulnerabilities (The Block, bitbank)
  • LNbits releases emergency version 1.7.0 after wallet thefts (Cointelegraph, bitbank)
  • Arcus, a DEX on Robinhood Chain, loses about $2.23 million to an accounting bug (Crypto Times)
  • Mercado Bitcoin to resume Pix deposits and withdrawals next week (Cointelegraph, bitbank)

item.title: Nov 10, 2026: PNC pilots USDC payments for corporate clients, Visa adds Monad for stablecoin settlement, Bottomline sends first USDC payment
item.description:
PNC Bank began a pilot letting corporate clients receive USDC payments that land as dollar deposits, Visa added Monad to its stablecoin settlement program, and Bottomline completed its first cross-border USDC payment. Elsewhere, hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation pushed bitcoin below 74,000 dollars and miner MARA disclosed 1.1 billion dollars in bitcoin sales.

  • PNC Bank pilots USDC payment acceptance for corporate clients, converted into dollar deposits (The Block, Cointelegraph, CoinPost)
  • Visa adds Monad to its stablecoin settlement networks (The Block)
  • Bottomline completes its first cross-border USDC payment (Bottomline)
  • Circle moves USYC's underlying fund into Treasury bills of up to six months (crypto.news)
  • Digital Garage signs MOU with Circle affiliate; its merchant payment platform supports USDC on Arc (あたらしい経済)
  • Canada's budget would require banks to issue stablecoins via non-financial subsidiaries (bitbank)
  • Japan's SESC seeks injunction against three unregistered firms that pitched bitcoin ETF exposure (CoinPost, NADA NEWS)

  • Follow-up: Former Binance investigator says Iran-linked account probe was ignored (Forbes) (bitbank, Crypto Times)
  • Poland's lower house passes sanctions bill covering crypto freezes (Cointelegraph)
  • China's internet regulator publishes blockchain filing rules banning crypto terms in service names (bitbank)
  • U.S. October CPI beats forecasts; bitcoin slips below 74,000 dollars (CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Crypto Times)
  • Spot bitcoin ETFs see more outflows; IBIT down 1.66 billion dollars over seven sessions (Cointelegraph)
  • MARA sold 13,597 BTC for about 1.1 billion dollars and repaid its bitcoin-backed loans (The Block, CoinDesk, CoinPost)
  • Trump Media swings to a 410 million dollar Q3 profit on crypto gains (The Block, CoinPost, bitbank)
  • Morgan Stanley to acquire transfer agent Vinyl Equity for tokenization (CoinPost, あたらしい経済, bitbank)
  • Securitize agrees to buy River One; Q3 revenue up 13 percent (The Block, Cointelegraph, CoinPost)

  • Walt launches a standalone app outside Telegram (The Block, CoinDesk)
  • Deribit to delay open interest data by eight hours (bitbank)
  • eToro's Q3 profit falls 74 percent (The Block)
  • BitGo's Q3 revenue falls about 51 percent (The Block, Cointelegraph, bitbank)

item.title: Nov 09, 2026: New Zealand drafts stablecoin rules, Raycash launches private stablecoin payments, Coinbase wins full OCC trust charter
item.description:
New Zealand proposed an interim framework for New Zealand dollar stablecoins, Raycash launched confidential stablecoin payments on Ethereum, and South Korea's draft digital asset law would limit won stablecoin issuance to bank-led groups. Elsewhere, Coinbase's national trust charter took effect and bitcoin fell to its lowest level since August.

  • South Korea's draft digital asset law would cap exchange shareholders and limit won stablecoins to bank-led issuers (bitbank)

  • Japan's FSA warns of phishing emails and urges passkeys (CoinPost, bitbank)
  • Sen. Blumenthal renews records demand to Binance, Tether and two Trump-linked crypto firms (CoinPost, Cointelegraph, bitbank)
  • Trump says he knows nothing about foreign investment in World Liberty Financial (The Block, CoinPost, Crypto Times)
  • PBoC governor says China will tighten oversight of RWA tokenization (bitbank)
  • ECB, European Commission and ESMA seek members for tokenization standards group (Cointelegraph)
  • South Korea's Supreme Court sets rules for seizing crypto in civil enforcement (bitbank)
  • Bitcoin hits lowest since August as liquidations top $1 billion (The Block, Cointelegraph, CRYPTO TIMES)
  • Strategy buys 1,036 bitcoin and repurchases STRC shares (The Block, Cointelegraph, CoinPost)
  • Nvidia perpetual futures slide on crypto venues after CEO probe (The Block, Crypto Times, bitbank)

  • NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks (The Block, CoinDesk)

item.title: Oct 26, 2026: Canada's no-interest stablecoin rules, Anchorpoint's retail delay, Circle Match
item.description:
Canada opens a consultation on draft stablecoin rules that keep a ban on paying interest to holders; Standard Chartered's Anchorpoint declines to commit to a retail launch date in Hong Kong; Circle launches hourly auctions that pair USDC issuance and redemption for institutions. Plus the GMO Internet extortion demand, Sony-backed Soneium's token plan, bitcoin back below 80,000 dollars before the Fed, and the Electrum fee-bump bug.

  • Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules and keeps the ban on paying interest to holders (CoinDesk)
  • Anchorpoint, the Standard Chartered-led Hong Kong dollar stablecoin venture, will not commit to a retail launch date (Cointelegraph, bitbank)
  • Circle launches Circle Match, hourly auctions pairing institutional USDC issuance and redemption orders (CRYPTO TIMES)
  • GMO Internet breach: a person claiming responsibility demands 1 million dollars; group shares fall as much as 11% (CRYPTO TIMES, CRYPTO TIMES)
  • Soneium, the Sony joint venture's Ethereum layer two, announces plans for a SONEIUM token (CoinPost, Neweconomy, bitbank)
  • South Korea's presidential office says a fourth crypto tax delay is under review but not decided (Neweconomy, CoinPost, The Block)
  • California's financial regulator asks the SEC to drop a provision removing state pre-sale review (NADA NEWS)
  • MEXC phases out service in the Netherlands, citing the lack of a MiCA license (bitbank)
  • Bitcoin slips below 80,000 dollars again before the Fed meeting; US spot ETFs took in about 301 million dollars last week (CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, NADA NEWS)
  • Strategy pauses bitcoin purchases after five weeks and buys back about 205 million dollars of STRC preferred shares (The Block, bitbank)
  • Strive buys 6,182 bitcoin, lifting holdings to 43,000 (The Block, bitbank)
  • Aviva Investors lists a tokenized share class of its sterling liquidity fund on the XRP Ledger with Ripple (The Block, Cointelegraph, bitbank)
  • Tether says 15 mining firms, including Bitmain, MicroBT and Canaan, will support its open-source mining kit MDK (CRYPTO TIMES)
  • Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise (Cointelegraph, bitbank)
  • Lido opens validators of up to 2,048 ETH to any operator with its 0x02 CSM (CRYPTO TIMES)
  • The eCash hard fork of bitcoin is set for around October 29th, with a 1-for-1 ECX airdrop (Crypto Times)
  • Electrum fixes a bug that let rogue servers steal funds when users raised a transaction fee (CoinDesk)
  • SlowMist finds more than 1,500 phishing sites tied to the DarkSword attack on iPhones (CoinPost, Neweconomy, NADA NEWS)
  • Solana trading bot BloomTrading loses about 954,000 dollars from 49 wallets and promises full refunds (Crypto Times)
  • Foundation traces phishing emails to Passport wallet users to compromised Cloudflare API keys (Crypto Times, bitbank)
  • Keystone customers say the breach exposed order data the company promised to delete after 180 days (The Block)
  • Bithumb and Upbit flag INIT as high risk after Initia's 2.7 million dollar exploit (Crypto Times)
